subject: Loss of error border for numeric input out of range

messages.author: 33a1d182cc2097d6
messages.subject: Loss of error border for numeric input out of range
parts: I just upgraded from 0.10.x to 0.12.2 and noticed that a feature has disappeared (or changed enough that I no longer see it).  When entering a value into a numericInput, if the value was out of range, a red border was added to the input.  But it no longer works.  Do I need to do something else to activate that?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Loss of error border for numeric input out of range
parts:
I believe this behavior is defined by the web browser instead of shiny
(I could be wrong). That said, I can reproduce this issue and I do
remember previously there was a red border. Perhaps it was because we
changed something in shiny (I don't know) or web browsers no longer
show the red border.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Loss of error border for numeric input out of range
parts:
It looks like this behavior was removed in Bootstrap 3, which Shiny switched to in version 0.11.

The reasoning behind the change is discussed here:
  https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/8093


There's an open issue in Shiny for this (and another closely-related change):
  https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/927

-Winston
